info.title: Valio Aimo trust gateway (Junction 2026 prototype)
info.description: How an external purchasing agent finds products, gets a fixed signed price, and orders from Valio Aimo, within a mandate the buyer set, seeing only what it should, on a hash-chained record. All data is synthetic. The same functions are available as an MCP server at /api/mcp.

get.description: Static data only (no price or stock). Hybrid keyword and semantic search, narrowed by SQL filters.

200.description: Products and whether semantic search contributed.

parameters.name: claims
parameters.description: Comma-separated claims every product must have, e.g. FREE_FROM_LACTOSE.

parameters.name: excludeAllergens
parameters.description: Comma-separated allergen codes to exclude (contains or may contain).

parameters.name: mandateId
parameters.description: Ties the search to a mandate in the decision record.

post.summary: Turn a plain-language need into offers
post.description: A language model reads the need; code converts quantities, prices only a shortlist live, builds offers and holds a quote for the default one. Takes up to a minute.

post.description: The mandate decides: confirmed, pending_approval or rejected, with reasons. Needs an unexpired, fulfillable quote whose signature still matches.

409.description: Conflict, for example a quote that cannot be ordered or already ordered, or another request with the same Idempotency-Key is still being processed

429.description: Rate limit reached (20 per 60 s per mandate). Wait `Retry-After` seconds. Limiting is off when the gateway has no Valkey.

422.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different quote

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. The first successful response is kept for 24 hours and returned again, with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`, for any retry with the same key and quote (instead of a 409 for an already ordered quote). Needs Valkey; ignored without it.

get.description: How one buyer's orders behave over time: weekly spend, outcomes, time to human decision, carbon, delivery reliability, top products, order size. Answered from ClickHouse when configured and reachable, otherwise Postgres (`source` says which). Includes real orders and clearly separated synthetic demo history; `infra` reports Kafka and ClickHouse as configured, healthy or not.

get.summary: Verify the decision record's hash chain
get.description: Re-computes every hash. valid=false names the first event that was changed, removed or reordered.

post.summary: Check a product against the live web
post.description: Oxylabs search and scrape, a model extracts statements, code keeps only quotes that are on the page. Reused for 24 hours; takes up to two minutes.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: true to ignore a stored check.

409.description: Conflict, for example a quote that cannot be ordered

post.description: JSON-RPC 2.0. Methods: initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call. Tools: search_products, request_offers, create_quote, place_order, get_order_status, verify_product, get_mandate. There is no approve tool. Connect: `claude mcp add --transport http valio-aimo http://localhost:3000/api/mcp`.

schema.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 request, notification, or a batch (array) of them.

get.description: The endpoint is stateless, so there is no server-initiated stream.
Ed25519 (JWK). Verify a quote's signature over its canonical terms with the key whose kid equals signature.keyId.

get.summary: Backing service health and cache statistics
get.description: Whether Postgres and Valkey are configured and answering. Valkey is optional: without it, caching, rate limiting and idempotency are off and everything else works. `cache` counts Valio API calls saved (hits) and made (misses).

autoApproveLimitEur.description: Orders up to this total (ex VAT) are confirmed without a human.

maxOrderEur.description: Orders above this are rejected. Between the two limits a human must approve.

oneOf.description: 0-1. A product delivered in full less often needs a human.

requireConfirmedStock.description: Terminal stock (supplier ships it, quantity unknown) needs a human.

oneOf.description: kg CO2-eq per kg (a product-group average). A product with a higher footprint needs a human.

preferredOffer.description: The offer held as a quote by default when a request has more than one.

Mandate.description: What the buyer has authorised the agent to decide alone.

StockView.description: Stock as an agent sees it. The quantity is never exposed.

value.description: Base64url Ed25519 signature over the canonical offer terms.

expiresAt.description: Prices are held until this time.

ExposedQuote.description: A fixed-price offer. The signature covers the commercial terms (see /.well-known/jwks.json).

items.description: Why the mandate sent the order to a human or rejected it.

similarity.description: Fused keyword and semantic rank score; comparable only within one result list.

Product.description: Static catalog data: no price, no stock.

oneOf.description: Litres or kilos this line covers.
Lowest delivery reliability among the lines, 0-1.

Offer.description: A complete way to fill the request.

models.description: Which open-weights model did each language step.

excludedByMandate.description: Matching products hidden because they contain a blocked allergen.

policy.description: What the mandate would decide if the quote were ordered now.

liveChecks.description: Null when the request had no required claims and the mandate blocks no allergens.

evidence.description: A passage copied from the page. Code checked that it appears in the page text.

totals.description: realOrders were placed through the gateway; syntheticOrders are generated demo history. confirmedSpend is EUR ex VAT.

weeks.description: Confirmed spend per week (Monday, UTC); syntheticSpend is the demo-history part.

stream.description: Decision events that arrived in ClickHouse through Kafka. Null unless ClickHouse answered.

summary.description: One plain-language sentence: what happened and why.

oneOf.description: SHA-256 over the previous hash and this event.
Newest hash. Publish it elsewhere to also expose removed events.

reasons.description: Every rule that fired, in plain language. Empty when the order is inside the mandate.

PolicyDecision.description: What the buyer's mandate decides about an order.

RecallCheck.description: A search of the Finnish Food Authority's (Ruokavirasto) recall notices for one product. A none_found result still carries the query, request ids and sources searched.

quote.description: Copied from the notice; code checked it is on the page and names the product or brand.

LiveChecks.description: Live-web checks run automatically before the policy preview, for the products the offers would order.

skipped.description: Why a check is missing, e.g. a timeout or an Oxylabs error.
